description: The sole contemporary candidate reports une cinquantaine (about fifty) contract teachers; this is approximate and gives no defensible lower bound of 50.

description: The account calls the event a demonstration at the Anjouan public-service office, but does not establish whether it was open to the public or a closed delegation, or name the employer/authority receiving the demand.
required_followup: Locate a contemporaneous description of the gathering and identify the employing or addressed public authority before resolving eligibility and target.

description: The gathering date is reported as February 11, but its physical end and all seven state-response categories remain unknown. Wage arrears began earlier and do not establish protest duration.
required_followup: Seek dated follow-up on the gathering, any response, and when participants dispersed; keep each unsupported response field unknown.

description: Only one contemporary article was opened. It mentions an activist Facebook live without a URL; no independent same-story account or original recording was located in this pass.
required_followup: If a public original or independent report is located, review its origin and relation to S001 before treating it as corroboration.

description: The 18 captured search invocations were French- and English-heavy, plus one Arabic-script and one transliterated Shikomori-name query; French-indexed local media dominated. No fluent Shikomori review, native-language phrase set, audio/social archive review, LexisNexis search, or complete newspaper-archive review was performed.
required_followup: Use fluent Shikomori and Arabic review and accessible local archives if greater coverage is needed; absence from this open-web pass is not evidence of no event.

description: Searches named Ngazidja/Grande Comore, Moroni, Anjouan/Ndzuani/Mutsamudu and Mohéli/Mwali/Fomboni, while the candidate is on Anjouan. Search visibility was uneven across the three islands; French-administered Mayotte and diaspora reporting were kept outside the Comoros event scope.
required_followup: Seek island-specific local records where accessible and keep Mayotte and diaspora actions distinct from the three-island Comoros unit.

description: The January unit contains earlier transport/curfew reporting, while a March 18 search result says an Anjouan shutdown planned for March 17 was not followed. No reviewed evidence links either item to the February 11 teachers’ gathering or establishes a cross-month physical episode.
required_followup: Keep actions with their evidenced dates; reopen continuity only if a source documents the same physical mobilization across the February boundary.

description: This is a provisional worker-coded candidate, not an official Mass Mobilization record. The eligibility threshold remains unresolved and the coordinator’s official-baseline gate is pending.
